answer_1.quote: Voice conversion (VC) aims to transfer a speaker's voice to that of another speaker without changing the linguistic content.

answer_2.quote: For objective evaluations, a neural network-based system with open-source implementation is used to measure speech quality (WV-MOS). Character error rate (CER) measured by an ASR model indicates the speech intelligibility. Speaker similarity (SSIM) is calculated by an SV model.

answer_4.quote: The mean opinion score (MOS) subjectively measures speech naturalness (NMOS) and speaker similarity (SMOS), which are calculated with 95% confidence intervals. We randomly select 120 testing pairs for subjective evaluations involving a group of 15 listeners.
answer_4.guideline: Measures speech naturalness and speaker similarity using MOS scores
